methods.steps: ffmpeg -i handset.3g2 -c:v libx264 -c:a aac handset-share.mp4
methods.limits: Requires the input decoder and selected encoders; lossy re-encoding.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i archive-phone.3g2 -c copy archive-phone.mp4
methods.limits: Stream copy; MP4 must accept the existing codecs.

methods.steps: Add File(s), Output Format MP4, Encoder Options, Save to Folder, Convert.
methods.limits: Vendor marks 3G2 input Windows only; no damaged-file repair guarantee.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i capture-master.avi -c copy capture-master.mkv
methods.limits: Automatic stream selection; supported codecs required. This is a remux.

methods.steps: HandBrakeCLI --input avi-review.avi --output avi-review.mkv --format av_mkv --encoder x264 --aencoder av_aac --quality 22
methods.limits: Re-encodes video rather than stream-copying; review track selection and installed CLI options.

methods.steps: Add AVI, set Output Format MKV, review Encoder Options, set Save to Folder, Convert.
methods.limits: AVI codecs must be available; choices depend on installation.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i web-source.avi -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 1024k -crf 32 -c:a libopus web-delivery.webm
methods.limits: Constrained-quality VP9 form; requires libvpx-vp9 and libopus encoders; lossy output.

methods.steps: Open Source and choose the AVI; choose WebM as the container; pick one of the video encoders HandBrake lists for WebM.
methods.limits: Video transcoding; encoder choices depend on the container.

methods.steps: Add file, choose WebM output, configure encoder and folder, Convert.
methods.limits: Available options depend on the installed edition and decoders.

methods.steps: Open the BMP; choose File > Export As; in the JPEG export dialog set the quality from 0 to 100 (default 85).
methods.limits: Lossy JPEG; deliberate flattening needed for transparency.

methods.steps: magick scan-bitmap.bmp -quality 90 scan-photo.jpeg
methods.limits: Example quality chosen explicitly; BMP variants depend on decoder support.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i field-recording.caf -c:a pcm_s16le field-edit.wav
methods.limits: Requires CAF codec support; 16-bit output can reduce source depth.

methods.steps: Add the CAF; choose WAV as the Output Format; set Encoder Options and the Save to Folder; Convert.
methods.limits: Vendor lists CAF input and WAV output; available options depend on the installation.

methods.steps: File > Export; set Save as type to JPEG, enter the file name, optionally choose Export this page only or Selected only; click Export; an export dialog follows.
methods.limits: Requires CorelDRAW; JPEG is raster and flattens the page.

methods.steps: Open the CDR in Draw; export it as JPEG (the book lists JPEG among Draw's graphics export formats); no menu path is given.
methods.limits: Imported through libcdr; Draw's guide lists Corel Draw (*.cdr) among the formats it opens.

methods.steps: File > Convert and save; select an image, choose a destination, enter a file name and select an image type; save.
methods.limits: Requires a version that supports the camera model.

methods.steps: Develop supported CR3 in Editor; disk icon opens a Save As dialog (name, location, format, bit depth, compression level); save immediately or queue; the gears icon queues.
methods.limits: CR3 decoding arrived in 5.8; check metadata and camera support.

methods.steps: Open the export module; target file on disk; choose the JPEG format, set quality (default 95) and size; Export.
methods.limits: CR3 support depends on version and camera.

methods.steps: Open the DXF; File > Export; the export list includes JPEG.
methods.limits: LibreCAD does not implement every DXF feature; supported versions run through DXF 2007.

methods.steps: dwg2bmp -o plan-review.jpg -x 2400 plan-review.dxf
methods.limits: Command-line tool of QCAD Professional; the page lists it as dwg2bmpPRO in Professional installs; not run locally.

methods.steps: Open the DXF in Draw (AutoCAD Interchange Format (*.dxf) is listed among the formats it opens); export it as JPEG (JPEG is listed among Draw's graphics export formats); no menu path is given.
methods.limits: The guide gives no menu path or export options.

methods.steps: magick office-diagram.emf office-diagram.png
methods.limits: EMF is listed as readable on Windows only, with the size option supported.

methods.steps: Open the EMF; File > Export PNG Image (Shift+Ctrl+E); choose the export area (Page, Drawing, Selection or Custom), the image size and file name; Export.
methods.limits: Some imported formats lose unsupported features.

methods.steps: Open the EMF in Draw (Enhanced Windows Metafile is listed among the formats it opens); export it as PNG (PNG is listed among Draw's graphics export formats); no menu path is given.
methods.limits: The guide gives no menu path or export options.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i reaction-loop.gif -c:v mpeg4 -q:v 5 reaction-clip.avi
methods.limits: Lossy MPEG-4; no audio from a GIF; the -q:v scale is codec-dependent.

methods.steps: magick diagram-motion.gif -coalesce diagram-frame-%04d.png; then ffmpeg -framerate 10 -i diagram-frame-%04d.png -c:v mpeg4 diagram-motion.avi
methods.limits: Two tools; frame rate is set by you.
